question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?
expected_answer: 24 working days per calendar year.

question: I want to take 5 days off in a row. How far in advance must I submit the request?
expected_answer: At least 10 working days in advance (leave of 3 or more consecutive days).

question: Until when can I use the leave days I carried over from last year?
expected_answer: By 31 March; after that they are lost.

question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
expected_answer: For absences longer than 2 consecutive working days.

question: How many paid days off do I get for my own wedding?
expected_answer: 5 days of special paid leave.

question: What is the internal phone extension of the IT Service Desk?
expected_answer: Extension 3100 (for P1/P2 incidents or if portal/e-mail are not accessible).

question: What is the target resolution time for a P1 incident?
expected_answer: 4 hours (first response within 15 minutes).

question: What should I do if I receive a suspicious phishing email?
expected_answer: Do not click links or open attachments; use the Report Phishing button in Outlook or forward it to security@contoso-bs.example.

question: My laptop was stolen. How quickly must I report it and how?
expected_answer: Within 1 hour, by phone (extension 3100); it is always a P1 incident.

question: What time should I arrive on my first day and where?
expected_answer: At 09:00 at the reception in Building B, ground floor, with your ID card.

question: Which mandatory trainings must I complete in my first week?
expected_answer: Information Security Basics, GDPR and Data Protection, Health and Safety at Work - within the first 5 working days.

question: Can I take annual leave during my probation period?
expected_answer: Yes, up to 5 days, with the approval of your line manager.

question: How many days of parental leave do I get?
expected_answer: I don't know - only mentioned as a separate policy (HR-POL-007) that is not available.

question: Where do I get my salay?
expected_answer: I don't know - salary payment is not covered by the documents.

question: How many days per week can I work from home?
expected_answer: I don't know - the Hybrid Work Policy (HR-POL-010) is not available.

question: How do I set up the VPN on my laptop?
expected_answer: I don't know - VPN setup is not covered by the documents.

question: How many days of leave do I have?
expected_answer: Depends: 24 days for full-time, pro rata for part-time (e.g. 12 days for 20 h/week), plus 1 extra day per 5 years of service up to 27; special leave is separate.

question: How quickly will IT fix my problem?
expected_answer: Depends on the priority set by IT: P1 4 hours, P2 8 business hours, P3 3 business days, P4 10 business days.

question: Who should I contact if I have a problem?
expected_answer: Depends on the problem: IT Service Desk for technical issues (extension 3100), HR Service Desk for HR topics (extension 2400), line manager or buddy for day-to-day questions.

question: How many days do I have to submit the document?
expected_answer: Depends on the document: medical certificate within 5 working days after return; special leave proof within 30 days; ID and bank details at least 3 working days before the first day.
